Ya-Sin.
Ngifunga ngeKurani ekhaliphile.
Impela wena ungomunye weZithunywe.
Usendleleni eqondile.
Yembulelwe [iKurani] nguSomandla Onesihawu
Ukuze uxwayise abantu okhokho babo abangaxwayiswanga kangoba abanendaba.
Impela isijeziso siqinisekiwe kubaningi kubo, kungakho bengakholwa.
Impela Thina sibophe izintamo zabo ngamasongo afika ezilevini bavele babheka phezulu.
Futhi sifake isithiyo ngaphambi kwabo nangasemuva kwabo, sabamboza kangoba abasaboni.
Futhi kuyefana nje kubo, uyabaxwayisa noma awubaxwayisi angeke bakholwe.
Wena uxwayisa nje kuphela lowo olandela iSikhumbuzo [iKurani] futhi osaba Onomusa engamboni; ngakho-ke mhalalisele ngentethelelo nomvuzo omuhle.
Impela Thina sivusa abafileyo siphinde silobe lokho abakwenza nabakushiya emuva.
Benzele umzekelo wabantu bomuzi mhla kufika kuwo iZithunywa.
Mhla sithumela kubo ezimbili, baziphika. Saphinde sathumela esesithathu zathi: Impela thina sithunywe kini”.
Bathi: “Nina ningabantu nje abafana nathi futhi ayikho into eyembulelwe ngoNomusa, nina ninamanga nje”.
Zathi: “iNkosi yethu yazi kahle ukuthi impela thina sithunyelwe kini”.
Futhi umsebenzi wethu ukudlulisa umlayezo ocacile.
Bathi: “Impela thina sinibona nizosilethela amashwa; uma ningaphezi, sizonikhanda ngamatshe niphinde nithole kithi isijeziso esibuhlungu”.
Zathi: “Ukubikelwa kwenu kuyosala nani; ingabe kungenxa yokuthi niyelulekwa na? Impela ningabantu abangenamkhawulo.
Kwaqhamula indoda mphini le kude nomuzi igijima yathi: “Bantu bakithi, landelani iZithunywa”.
Landelani labo abanganiceli mvuzo futhi abasendleleni eqondile.
Ngingavinjwa yini ukuba ngikhonze lowo ongidalile futhi eniyobuyela kuYe na?
Ngingaziqokela kanjani ezinye izikhonzwa ngaphandle kwaKhe, kulapho uma Onomusa efuna ngehlelwe okubi, ushwele wazo awusoze wangisiza ngalutho futhi angeke bakhone nokungitakula.
Impela ngiyobe sengidukile ngokusobala.
Impela ngiyakholelwa eNkosini yenu; ngakho-ke ngilaleleni.
Kwathiwa [kuye]: “Ngena eJana”. Wathi: “Ngifisa engabe abantu bakithi bayazi…”
Ukuthi iNkosi yami ingethethelele kanjani futhi yangenza ngaba womunye wabahlonishwayo.
Asizange sithumele butho elivela phezulu emuva kwakhe [esebulelwe] futhi asilithumeli [ukubhubhisa].
Kwaba nje umsindo [ohlabayo] owodwa kuphela; bavele badindiliza [sebefile].
Yeka ukuzisola kwezigqila [kwelizayo! Njalo nje uma kufika kubo iSithunywa babesenza inhlekisa.
Ababoni yini ukuthi ziningi izizwe esizibhubhisile ngaphambilini kwabo nokuthi aziphindanga zabuya kubo.
Yileso naleso sizwe zonke ziyolethwa kiMi.
Futhi isibonakaliso sabo, umhlaba ofile esiwuvuselele sakhiqiza kuwo izinhlavu abazidlayo.
Senza kuwo kwaba nezivande zamasundu nemivini saphinde saqhekeza sagelezisa kuwo imithombo.
Ukuze badle ezithelweni zawo [amanzi aniselayo] ezingeziwanga izandla zabo; kungani-ke bengabongi na?
Ungcwele lona odale zonke izinhlobo ezikhiqizwa umhlaba nezabo uqobo [umfazi nendoda] nezalokho abangakwazi.
Futhi isibonakaliso sabo ubusuku, sisusa kubo imini ngalokho bazithola sebesebumnyameni.
Futhi ilanga lihamba [kumzila walo] lize lifike la eliphelela khona; lokho kuhlelwe nguSomandla Owaziyo.
Futhi nenyanga sayibekela izimo [ezahlukene] kuze lapho [iyafiphala] njengoswazi [lwesundu] oludala.
Ilanga ngeke liyifice inyanga futhi nobusuku ngeke bundlule imini; konke kubhukuda [kuhamba] emkhathini.
Futhi isibokaliso sabo ukuthi salayisha izizukulwane zabo emkhunjini ogcwele.
Saphinde sabadalela okufana nawo [umkhumbi] abakugibelayo.
Uma sithanda besingabacwilisa bengasizwa muntu futhi bengatakulwa.
Ngaphandle komusa ovela kithi nokuthi baphile kuze kufike isikhathi [sokufa esibekiwe].
Uma betshelwa ukuthi: “Sabani lokhu okuphambi kwenu [elizayo] nokusemuva kwenu [impilo yasemhlabeni] ukuze nihawukelwe.
Futhi noma yisiphi isibonakaliso kuzibonakaliso zeNkosi yabo esifika kubo, bavele basishaye indiva.

Uma betshelwa ukuthi: “Nikelani ngalokho u Allah anabele kona”. Laba abangakholwa bathi kulaba abakholwayo: “Singabondla kanjani laba u Allah uma ethanda engabondla Yena ngokwaKhe, impela nina nidukile ngokusobala”.
Futhi bathi: “Kanti siyofika nini lesi sethembiso uma ngempela niqinisile na?”
Balindele nje kuphela umsindo owodwa oyobahlasela bengazelele bematasa.
Angeke bakhone ngisho ukulayezela futhi angeke bakhone nokubuyela emndenini yabo.
Kuyoshaywa uphondo; bese bephuma emathuneni baye eNkosini yabo.
Bayothi: “Kwaphela ngathi, ubani kodwa lona osivuse la ebesilele khona na?. Yikona lokhu Onomusa akuthembisile futhi neZithunywa beziqinisile”.
Kwaba nje umsindo owodwa, bonke balethwa phambi kweThu.
Namhlanje akukho muntu oyokwenziwa okungebulungiswa futhi niyothola umvuzo walokho ebenikwenza.
Impela namhlanje abaseJana bamatasa bayancebeleka.
Bona nabalingani babo phansi kwemithunzi beqhiyeme emibhedeni.
Bayothola kuyo izithelo nalokho abafunayo.
Ukuthula, izwi eliyovela eNkosini Enesihawu.
Futhi [kuyothiwa]: “Nina zephula mthetho phumelani eshashalazini”.
Nina bantwana baka Adamu, asizange yini sense isibopho nani ukuthi ningakhonzi uShayitani ngokuba impela uyisitha senu esisobala.
Nokuthi nikhonze Mina kuphela; lena iyona ndlela eqondile.
Impela udukise uquqaba olunigi kini; aninakuqonda na?
Iyona-ke lena iJahanamu ebenithenjiswe yona.
Ngenani kuyo namhlanje ngenxa yokungakholwa kwenu.
Namhlanje sizovala imilomo yenu, bese sikhulunyiswa izandla zenu futhi nemilenze yenu iyofakaza ngalokho ababekwenza.
Uma sithanda singavala amehlo abo, bese bephuthuma indlela; kepha bayoyibona kanjani na?
Futhi uma sithanda singabaguqula isimo sabo semvelo khona ezindaweni zabo, bahluleke ukunyakaza noma ukubuyela [esimeni].
Futhi lowo eminika impilo ende, simenza abe buthaka emzimbeni; kungani ningaqondi na?
Futhi asimfundisanga ubumbongi futhi akakudingi. Kuyisikhumbuzo nje neKurani ecacisayo.
Ukuze axwayise lowo ophilayo nokuthi isinqumo [sesijeziso] sibafanele labo abangakholwa.
Ababoni yini ukuthi sibadalele kulokho esikwenze ngeZandla zeThu imfuyo baba ngabanikazi bayo.
Sabathambisela yona; kangoba ezinye bayazigibela kuthi ezinye bayazidla.
Futhi kuzo banezinsiza nokuphuzwayo; kungani bengabongi na?
Baziqokele izikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah ukuze basizakale.
Angeke zikwazi ukubasiza kunalokho bona bayibutho elihla liya kuzo [izikhonzwa].
Ngakho-ke makungakukhathazi abakushoyo. Impela Thina siyakwazi lokho abakufihlayo nalokho abakuveza obala.
Akaboni yini umuntu ukuthi simdale ngesidoda; kepha sekawumphikisi oqavile.
Usenzela thina imizekelo akhohlwe ukuthi udalwe kanjani; wathi: “Ubani ongavusa amathambo lapho esebunile na?”.
Yithi: “Ayovuswa ngulowo owadala kwasekuqaleni, futhi wazi ngayo yonke indalo”.
Lona onidalele umlilo ngesihlahla esiluhlaza [cwe]; nakhu nibasa ngaso.
Ingabe lona odale amazulu nomhlaba akakwazi yini ukudala okufana nawo na? Ukwazi impela; phela unguMdali Owaziyo.
Uma efuna ukwenza into ethile, uvele athi: “Yenzeka”, bese iyenzeka.
Ungcwele lona umbuso wezinto zonke useZandleni zaKhe futhi niyobuyela kuYe.
